answers.question_fr: Quelle est la date de mise en production actuellement approuvée, et avec quelle réserve?
answers.question_en: What production go-live date is currently approved, and with what reservation?
answers.answer_en: The currently approved go-live target is 22 October 2026. It was approved at the steering committee on 10 September 2026, when Élodie Caron formally stated the decision after no one objected. The approval was a decision, whereas Boréal's earlier email of 8 September was only a recommendation. The date is not an automatic go: Nicolas Perron (project lead since 16 September) stated it is conditional on three remaining validations (security, accessibility and operations readiness). At the 26 September committee these were specified as: security acceptance of SEC-210, closure of ACC-303, and approval of the runbook including rollback. As of the 30 September baseline, none of these conditions is documented as closed: SEC-210 is in validation, ACC-303 is open and OPS-601 is open.
answers.answer_fr: La date de mise en production approuvée est le 22 octobre 2026 (décision du comité du 10 septembre), mais elle est conditionnelle à trois validations : acceptation sécurité de SEC-210, fermeture de ACC-303 et approbation du runbook incluant le rollback.

answers.question_fr: Pourquoi la date a-t-elle changé, et quel est l'état actuel de la cause initiale?
answers.question_en: Why did the date change, and what is the current state of the initial cause?
answers.answer_en: The go-live target moved from 15 October to 22 October 2026 because the internal connector problem (INT-101) cost more time than planned. Boréal (Julien Moreau) proposed the move on 8 September, and the steering committee approved it on 10 September 2026; Marc Gervais confirmed the connector was the critical path. The initial cause is now resolved: on 17 September Boréal deployed a fix and replayed 120 searches with 120 valid responses, and Marc Gervais, who owns the integration side, validated and closed INT-101 the same day (an expired service token after a secret change, with token renewal logic then corrected). The 18 September follow-up meeting also records INT-101 as validated and closed. The 22 October date remains conditional on three other open items (SEC-210 security validation, ACC-303, runbook with rollback), which are not part of the connector cause.
answers.answer_fr: La date est passée du 15 au 22 octobre 2026 à cause du retard causé par le connecteur interne (INT-101), proposé par Boréal le 8 septembre et approuvé par le comité le 10 septembre. Cette cause est résolue : INT-101 a été validé et fermé par Marc Gervais le 17 septembre 2026.

answers.question_fr: Qui a approuvé le changement et quand? Distinguez proposition et approbation.
answers.question_en: Who approved the change and when? Distinguish proposal from approval.
answers.answer_en: The change is the move of the production go-live target from 15 October to 22 October 2026. It was first a proposal: on 8 September 2026 Julien Moreau (Boréal, the vendor) recommended 22 October and explicitly left the governance decision to the client. It was approved on 10 September 2026 at the steering committee (comité de direction). Élodie Caron, then project manager, formulated the decision and, after asking whether anyone objected, declared it approved. Sophie, Marc, Olivier and Nicolas voiced no objection, and Julien said 22 October was tenable for Boréal. The approval was not unconditional: Nicolas stressed that 22 October is not an automatic go, because the security, accessibility and operations criteria still apply. The committee of 26 September, chaired by Nicolas Perron, then made the target explicitly conditional on three items. No separate signed document is on file; the committee transcript is the authoritative record, and Nicolas later restated that the approved target remains 22 October.
answers.answer_fr: Le report du 15 au 22 octobre 2026 a été proposé par Boréal (Julien Moreau) le 8 septembre, puis approuvé au comité de direction du 10 septembre 2026, où Élodie Caron l'a déclaré approuvé sans opposition; il demeure conditionnel aux validations restantes.

answers.question_fr: Qui est responsable du projet et depuis quand?
answers.question_en: Who is responsible for the project and since when?
answers.answer_en: Nicolas Perron is the project lead for NOVA, effective 16 September 2026. This is a decision announced by Élodie Caron, the previous project lead, in an email to the NOVA team on that date. Her transition note and the Teams channel the same day confirm it, and Nicolas acknowledged taking over, including the Friday committee. Before that date Élodie Caron held the role, as set by the 7 July 2026 kickoff and the charter. Élodie said she would remain available for a few days to support the transfer, but decisions and follow-ups are to be directed to Nicolas. Plan V3 still lists Élodie as owner of the production go-live line (P-06) in the 12 September version, so that line is stale and must not override the 16 September transition.

answers.question_fr: Quel est le montant contractuel autorisé et comment se calcule-t-il?
answers.question_en: What is the authorized contract amount and how is it calculated?
answers.answer_en: The authorized contract amount is 204,000 CAD before tax: the initial maximum of 180,000 CAD (contract, charter and kickoff minutes) plus 24,000 CAD from change request CR-01, which the project committee approved on 14 August 2026. CR-01 is a documented decision, so it is a valid increase to the authorized amount. By contrast, CR-04 (18,000 CAD for advanced mobile optimization) is only a draft with no approval, and it was deferred to phase 2 on 24 September 2026, so it adds nothing to the authorized amount. The contract requires a written, approved change request before execution and invoicing. For context, invoiced to date is 60,000 + 72,000 + 54,000 = 186,000 CAD, of which 132,000 CAD is paid (INV-001 and INV-002); INV-003 is under validation. The 204,000 figure is my arithmetic from the two documents; no single file states the total.

answers.question_fr: Où les données de production doivent-elles être hébergées? Quelle preuve confirme la mise en œuvre?
answers.question_en: Where must production data be hosted? What evidence confirms the implementation?
answers.answer_en: Production data must be hosted in Canada, specifically Canada Central. This was proposed as a requirement by security (Sophie Lambert) on 22-23 July 2026, agreed orally by Marc, Sophie and Julien at the 23 July architecture workshop, and formalized as accepted in ADR-007 (decision date 23 July 2026). Implementation evidence: Boréal (Julien Moreau, 26 Aug 2026) declared the migration to Canada Central complete and sent schema v2 (dated 25 Aug, showing Canada Central). The 27 Aug committee minutes state the migration was declared complete by Boréal and verified by the architecture team, which is the validation. ADR-007 itself required a technical validation before production tests; the minutes are the only validation evidence I found, with no separate test report in the dossier. Boréal's completion email is a vendor delivery claim, so the committee verification is the stronger proof.
answers.answer_fr: Les données de production doivent demeurer au Canada, en Canada Central (ADR-007, décision du 23 juillet 2026). La mise en œuvre est confirmée par la migration déclarée terminée par Boréal (26 août, schéma v2) et vérifiée par l'équipe architecture au comité du 27 août.

answers.question_fr: La sécurité est-elle acceptée? Distinguez livraison et validation.
answers.question_en: Is security accepted? Distinguish delivery from validation.
answers.answer_en: No, security is not accepted as of 2026-09-30. Boréal (Julien Moreau) delivered a SEC-210 fix to the validation environment on 19 September and considers it resolved, but that is a delivery backed only by the vendor's automated tests. Sophie Lambert (security) stated she must redo her own scenario and that the ticket must not be closed before security validation. On 26 September she said security acceptance had not yet been given, a re-test was only planned, and the ticket status remained EN VALIDATION. The ticket was originally raised on 12 September as blocking before production: the EXPORT_CSV audit line lacked the object (case ID) and the result. Security validation of SEC-210 is one of the three go-live conditions for the 22 October target, and the risk register (R-02) still lists it as open. No re-test date or result is documented (TBC), and no security acceptance has been recorded.

answers.question_fr: L'accessibilité est-elle complétée? Identifiez ce qui reste à corriger.
answers.question_en: Is accessibility complete? Identify what remains to be fixed.
answers.answer_en: No, accessibility is not complete as of 2026-09-30. ACC-301 (missing field label) and ACC-302 (status contrast) were fixed by Boréal and validated and closed by Mélissa Gagnon on 15 and 20 August. ACC-303, opened 17 September with high priority, is still OPEN: in the edit modal, keyboard Tab never reaches the Enregistrer (Save) button. Boréal reproduced it on 18 September and announced a fix in the next build, which is a promise and not a delivery or validation. Mélissa considers ACC-303 an accessibility blocker before production, and the 26 September committee made its closure one of the three go-live conditions for the 22 October target. The remaining work is therefore to deliver the ACC-303 fix and have Mélissa re-test and validate it; no closure date is documented (TBC).

answers.answer_en: The three go-live conditions were stated by Nicolas Perron at the 26 September 2026 steering committee and confirmed by Sophie, Mélissa and Olivier: (1) security validation of SEC-210, (2) closure of ACC-303, and (3) approval of the runbook including rollback. They condition the 22 October target, which was approved on 10 September; the 22 is not an automatic go. Status at baseline (30 Sept): SEC-210 is EN VALIDATION (Boréal delivered a fix on 19 Sept, but Sophie has not accepted it and a re-test is planned, date TBC); ACC-303 is OUVERT (the Save button is unreachable by keyboard in the modal; Boréal's fix is announced for the next build, no date documented); OPS-601 is OUVERT (on 29 Sept Olivier still had not received the final version). The runbook capture dated 25 September shows steps 1-3 OK, step 4 (rollback / retour arrière procedure) marked TODO, and step 5 (post-deployment functional validation) marked À compléter, so two items are missing: rollback and post-deployment validation. Owners and deadlines for completing them are not documented; Julien said he would chase Boréal's ops team (a statement, not a dated commitment), and Olivier Côté gives the ops go.

contradictions.a: The charter and the stale plan V3 still show 15 October as the production target.

aCit.quote: Date cible de mise en production : 15 octobre 2026

contradictions.b: The steering committee approved 22 October on 10 September. The vendor's 8 September email was only a proposal.

bCit.quote: Donc **approuvé**. Le 22 devient la date officielle.
il s'agit d'une proposition de notre part

contradictions.resolution: The committee decision of 10 September (22 October) prevails over the charter, which is not updated automatically. Plan V3 was not corrected, as Nicolas himself noted. The 22 October date is conditional on three go-live conditions.

contradictions.topic: Status report says green and complete vs open tickets
contradictions.a: The 21 September status report and Alex's draft say security and accessibility are green or completed.

aCit.quote: Sécurité VERT Correctif SEC-210 livré Accessibilité VERT Correctifs appliqués
La sécurité et l'accessibilité sont complétées et le projet vise le 22 octobre.

contradictions.b: SEC-210 is still in validation, ACC-303 is open as a blocker, and the runbook is incomplete.
contradictions.resolution: The report was prepared before the detailed ticket checks, and ticket statuses and the 26 September committee outweigh it. Security and accessibility are not complete. The draft communication must not go out as written.

contradictions.topic: SEC-210: vendor says fixed vs security has not accepted
contradictions.a: Boréal says the fix is deployed and the problem is corrected.

aCit.quote: Le correctif pour SEC-210 est déployé en validation depuis ce matin.
Fix déployé sur l'environnement de validation. Pour nous c'est réglé.

contradictions.b: Sophie states that security acceptance has not been given and the ticket must stay open until her re-test.

bCit.quote: Nous n'avons pas encore donné l'acceptation sécurité de SEC-210.
Ne pas fermer avant validation sécurité.

contradictions.resolution: Delivery is not validation. The security owner has the authority, and the status remains EN VALIDATION with a re-test planned on 26 September. No result is documented.

contradictions.topic: Accessibility: Boréal says compliant vs ACC-303 open
contradictions.a: Boréal's 20 August email says everything should be compliant. The 27 August committee notes cover the label and contrast fixes only.

aCit.quote: Tout devrait maintenant être conforme de notre côté.

contradictions.b: ACC-303, opened on 17 September, shows that the keyboard focus never reaches Enregistrer. Mélissa treats it as a blocker.

bCit.quote: le bouton Enregistrer n'est jamais atteint avec Tab
Pour moi c'est un bloquant d'accessibilité avant production.

contradictions.resolution: The 20 August claim predates ACC-303 (17 September) and concerned ACC-301 and ACC-302, which are closed. ACC-303 is the later fact and is still open.

contradictions.topic: Risk register still shows the connector as an open risk
contradictions.a: The 29 September risk register keeps R-01 (connector delay) open, with a comment dated 9 September.
contradictions.b: INT-101 was validated and closed by Marc on 17 September, and the delivery follow-up confirms it.

bCit.quote: le connecteur interne a été validé et fermé le 17 septembre

contradictions.resolution: The R-01 line is stale: it was last updated before the 17 September closure. The cause of the date change is resolved. The register should be updated (recommendation).

contradictions.topic: Mobile CR-04: invoiced vs not approved
contradictions.a: INV-003 bills 18,000 $ for mobile optimisation under CR-04, as if it were approved.
contradictions.b: CR-04 is a draft with no approval. It was deferred to phase 2, and no expense may be engaged or invoiced without new approval.

bCit.quote: Aucun numéro d’approbation ni signature de comité n’est présent dans ce document.
Aucune dépense additionnelle liée à CR-04 ne doit être engagée sans nouvelle approbation.

contradictions.resolution: The invoice reference does not prove approval. The 18,000 $ line is unauthorised under the contract's change-control clause and should not be released.

contradictions.topic: Project owner: Élodie vs Nicolas in the plan
contradictions.a: Plan V3 still lists Élodie Caron as accountable for production release, and the charter names her as project manager.
contradictions.b: Nicolas Perron officially took over on 16 September.

bCit.quote: Nicolas Perron prend officiellement la charge du projet NOVA à compter d'aujourd'hui, 16 septembre.

contradictions.resolution: The transition email and note of 16 September are later than the charter and the V2 plan. Nicolas is the owner. Plan V3 already shows him on P-06, but its date is still 15 October.

sections.text: The approved go-live date is 22 October 2026. Boréal proposed it on 8 September and the steering committee approved it on 10 September with no objection. It is not a guaranteed go. It depends on three open conditions: security validation of SEC-210, closure of ACC-303, and an approved runbook that includes rollback.
